text:
Stop posting photos that kill your status.

Your camera never took a bad photo. Your life did.

What gets you matches:
Travel with location tags. Formal outfits. A powerful dog. Athletic shirtless if you have the body. Beach or pool if you have the body. Women actually enjoying your company. Extreme sports. Small groups (three or four) of sharp friends.

One message: your life isn't boring. Everything else is just proof.
caption:
Your camera never took a bad photo. Your life did.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
